deals.terms: All cash. Closed after regulatory clearance.
deals.rationale: Per Titan's release: adds Aster's palletising line to its warehouse range.
deals.so_what: For dealmakers: the second warehouse-robotics buyout this quarter, both paid in cash.

report_markdown:
**Titan Automation closed its $220 million cash acquisition of Aster Robotics on 2026-11-13.** It was signed on 2026-11-06 and cleared by the regulator. Titan says it adds Aster's palletising line to its warehouse range.

Nothing else this week.
